eyebrow: EFW2 wage file · step by step
title: A wage file is a stack of 512-byte lines, read by position
intro: One small test file (01) played start to finish. Every number comes from the generated TY2025 files.

1.title: Every line is 512 bytes, and its first two letters say what it is
1.body: File 01 has 7 lines: **RA RE RW RW RW RT RF**. A file for several clients repeats RE, its RW lines and RT once per employer.

2.title: One W-2 is one RW line, at fixed byte positions
2.body: Maria's box 1 wages of 52000.00 become 5200000 cents, written `00005200000` at RW 188-198. One byte too many or too few and every field after it moves, so SSA requires exactly 512 bytes.

3.title: RT adds up the RW lines, RF counts them
3.body: 52000.00 + 38500.50 + 71250.00 = 161750.50, written `000000016175050` at RT 10-24. SSA checks each RT against the RW lines since the last RE.

4.title: Each broken test file breaks one rule on purpose
4.body: File 94's RT is 100.00 more than its RW lines, file 95's RF says 4 for 3 RW lines, and file 97 has one 511-byte line, which stops testing.
